audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Gangplank five of seven stages at 2/10 in a lane Tryndamere wins 53.91% of, and they disagree with the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirrored gangplank__tryndamere audit set both charts to Tryndamere / Gangplank / Tryndamere / Skill / Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Skill. Mirror is authoritative; mirror-fix.js would overwrite any disagreement anyway.
audit.corrected: Tryndamere, Gangplank, Tryndamere, Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Skill — proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text placed the lane flip at Gangplank's first item; nothing carried a cooldown number. Packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'.
audit.why: Stridebreaker completes before Trinity, so the first-item stage is still Tryndamere's; the evening-out is a two-item event. Numbers now on the page: Parrrley 4.5s, Remove Scurvy 22/20/18/16/14s, Cannon Barrage 160/140/120s, Spinning Slash 650 range, Undying Rage 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: First item is yours; two items evens it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Remove Scurvy was never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health.' It cleanses Mocking Shout's slow and heals through your chip, on 22s at rank 1 — the single most matchup-defining button he owns against you, and the reason Grievous Wounds timing matters.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy cleanses your Mocking Shout slow and heals him every 22s — commit after he spends it, and buy Executioner's before any long trade.

audit.why: 4.5s cooldown at every rank, 625 range, 50/45/40/35/30 mana. The poke is limited by his mana pool, not by the cooldown.
audit.corrected: Parrrley is up every 4.5s; his mana is the real limit on the poke.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing anywhere despite an enemy with a heal button and a crit-lifesteal build.
audit.why: Executioner's Calling is the concrete answer to Remove Scurvy plus his lifesteal.

edits.before: This is where it flips: Gangplank's first spike (Sheen/Essence Reaver + Trinity) turns his barrels and empowered Q into massive burst that can chunk you from range and self-heal his crit build. He out-ranges your all-in now — respect keg zones and stop diving him freely.
edits.after: Your Stridebreaker lands before his Trinity, so the first-item window is still yours — force it. Once he has Sheen online, barrel chains out-range your 650 spin, and Remove Scurvy cleanses your slow on a 22s cooldown, so buy Executioner's before you commit long.

edits.before: Late game favors Gangplank: stacked barrels detonate for huge AoE crit damage that beats your engage range, and his Cannon Barrage plus global gold snowball out-scale you. Don't chase him into keg fields; group with your team, and use R only to survive the barrel burst, not to force a losing extended fight.
edits.after: Late it comes down to positioning: stacked kegs detonate for AoE crit that beats your 650 engage range, but Undying Rage on an 80s cooldown at rank 3 survives any single chain. Don't walk through a keg field to reach him — spin off a flank minion, take the fight on clean ground, and split the map when he groups.

edits.before: The lane inverts at his first item. Trinity plus a crit component turns barrel chains into ranged burst that beats your engage, and his global gold and Cannon Barrage out-scale you. Stop diving keg fields, group up, and treat R as survival rather than a commit into his zone.
edits.after: Your first item still beats his — Stridebreaker completes before Trinity. It is two items on that evens out: barrel chains out-range your 650 spin and Remove Scurvy cleanses the slow every 22s. Buy Executioner's, fight on clean ground, and split rather than group.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Remove Scurvy (W): 22s at rank 1 — it cleanses your Mocking Shout slow and heals, so all-in after he eats it. - Parrrley (Q): 4.5s, so poke is constant; his mana is the real limit. - Undying Rage: 120s, 5 seconds.
